context: The scene takes place in the Emerald Grove just after a violent goblin attack that the player helped repel; survivors are wounded, healers and celebrants are tending the aftermath, and Halsin has returned but postponed any deeper talks until morning. Lakrissa is one of the tiefling refugees — sardonic and fearful — relieved to be alive yet bleak about the long road to Baldur’s Gate and convinced more killing could start again. Her lines swing between bitter relief (“we survived,” “we can finally leave”) and fatalism (“doesn’t look like any of us are going to make it”), reflecting the uncertain mood among survivors. Off‑screen flags (which goblin leaders live or died, whether any idols went missing, if drow or other threats remain, and whether the player bears a tadpole) will affect later conversation options.
